main_body: A grey stone stove, tall rectangular body with a light grey top panel (rows ~9-13) and a large front face with a dark firebox opening showing flame.
top_band: light grey band at rows ~9-12 with two small dark dots, then a lighter 1-row strip at row ~12-13; it reads as a front panel/hood face rather than a horizontal surface; no distinct top surface above it
evidence: Reading a column through the middle: the dark outline at row 8, then a light grey band (rows 9-12) with two dark dots, which looks like a vent plate or panel face, then a lighter 1-row line, then the mid-grey body (rows 14-30) with a dark firebox. The light band is the same material as the front and is not clearly foreshortened as a horizontal surface; no ellipse or opening on top. The firebox is inset with a dark border but the body is a flat front view. This is a front elevation with a light band as a hat.

style.evidence: The body is mostly flat grey with a faint tile grid; there are about 3 lightness steps in the stone ramp. The outline is a uniform dark, nearly neutral line. The firebox has some detail (flame in 3-4 yellows) but the large grey face and top panel are flat fills. Tiles carry far fewer colours than the stall and well references, which have many tones and textures.
